decided.singular: Days whose daily max reaches about 6.3 or more, with means well above the typical 2-3 baseline, set against neighbours sitting around 3-4 (the largest is day 316 at max 8.667, then day 1 at 8.0 and days 106 and 152 at 7.667).
decided.recurrence: Clusters of elevated means come back about every 27 days (roughly 41-46, 67-72, 94-95, 121-125, 149-154, 177, 204, 221, 245-249, 273, 301-303, 329-331, 355), though the spacing is irregular in places.
decided.quarter: Q2 has the densest run of high-mean days (94-95, 106, 111, 121-125, 137, 149-155, 163-164) and few long quiet stretches, while Q3 is visibly the quietest; Q4 has the single largest spikes but more quiet gaps.

answer.guess: The 3-hourly planetary geomagnetic Kp index (values in thirds, 0-9), probably for 2025 (day 316 = Nov 12 storm, day 1 = Jan 1, day 152 = Jun 1).
